documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in consulting operations. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in consulting operations who reported that their workflow stopped after a configuration change. They explicitly stated that this is a support incident and requested that support be involved before discussing any expansion. The account is in the 'customer' stage with verified consent and ownership by 'cedar-east'. The operational friction is the workflow stopping after a configuration change, which the customer described directly.
raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Since this is a support incident, we will escalate it to our support team for immediate assistance. Please rest assured that we are here to help resolve this issue as quickly as possible.
questions: Can you provide more details about the configuration change that caused the workflow to stop?
Have you already contacted the support team, or would you like us to escalate this for you?
uncertainties: The specific nature of the configuration change is unknown.
The current status of the support escalation is not confirmed.
